name: Ensemble Kalman Filter
summary: Sequential data assimilation approximating error covariances with an ensemble of model states.
core_idea: Propagate ensemble members and update them using empirical covariances and observed data.
innovation: Avoids propagating a full covariance matrix by using sample ensembles.
limitations: Finite ensembles introduce sampling errors and spurious correlations.
Nonlinear and non-Gaussian behavior can limit the approximation.
